verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm Cognee is open source and can be self-hosted via a single Docker command, run entirely on your own machine/stack for free, forever, including local UI via cognee.start_ui(). This directly matches the platform-engineer self-host story. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the Docker deployment (e.g., third-party report of running it in production), and docs on multi-node/scaling infra for self-hosted setups.
